title: Saudi Arabian Pine Nut Pudding
description: A creamy dessert made with pine nuts, reminiscent of traditional Saudi Arabian sweets. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: In a blender, blend the nutty milk, arabian honey, and lemon juice until smooth.
Add the pine nuts to the blender and blend until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the poach pears in the ramekins.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the pudding is set.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve cold, garnished with additional pine nuts if desired.
